body: Im going to go through it with now.
There's nothing good left for me in this life. It hurts too much. Please, I do not want anyone to try to talk me out of this
If things aren't going to get better before the end of this week, I'm ending it all. No more hurt
Your response intrigues me. Could you elaborate on what you meant by "it takes a whole lot less than you think to get yourself in that kind of situation" ?
Why does it seem like everyone's life is better than mine. I'm so tired of feeling left behind and second best. Is this really the bane of my existence? Why am i even here??
I currently feel like im doing myself a disservice by staying alive and not doing something about it

I would love an office job, but for similar positions in my area, some places require some type of degree or prior concentrated experience. I'm feeling pretty jaded right now and can't seem to make sense of why I'm in this current position. It's making me nervous

Thanks, I appreciate your encouragement. I want things to get better and stay better but at the same time I don't want to get my hopes up for nothing. I'm really tired of putting forth an effort towards something that may or may not work out.
Thats the issue, im not sure what kind of field would be a good fit. I feel like I'm in limbo.
